post.description:
Always issues a new session and ends the one the request carried, if any. A wrong password, an unknown
account and a disabled account get the same 401. Throttling (429), whether or not the account exists: each
client (address, or a browser that signed in to the account before) waits after 5 failures in a row, and
after 100 failures from clients the account does not know, only such browsers may try until a sign-in
succeeds or an admin unlocks it. A sign-in from a browser that has no device cookie for the account also sets
one (a second Set-Cookie, `__Host-device`, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, 180 days).

delete.description:
Deletes the account and everything it owns, ends all its sessions and clears the cookie. The session must
have signed in within the last 10 minutes: sign in again (POST /sessions) first, or the answer is 403
`reauthentication_required`. The only enabled admin cannot delete itself (409 `last_admin`).

password.title: Password
password.description: 15 to 128 characters (code points), no composition rules (NIST SP 800-63B-4). The minimum also applies after NFKC normalization, which can shorten a password (`e` plus a combining acute becomes `é`): a password under 15 characters after it is rejected with code `too_short`. A password on the common or breached password list is rejected with code `password_too_common`.

pointer.title: Pointer
pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the invalid value in the request body, or `/<name>` for a query or path parameter. Empty when the whole body is missing.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable machine-readable code: a failed contract rule, or a business rule such as `password_too_common`. The list grows (x-extensible-enum), so clients translate the values they know and fall back for the rest.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Human-readable explanation for developers; clients must not parse it.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

last_used_at.title: Last Used At
last_used_at.description: Updated at most once a minute. A session unused for the idle limit ends before `expires_at`.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: The absolute end of the session, however much it is used.
